summary.name: Cover Letter Copilot
summary.one_liner: An AI cover letter generator that drafts a personalized letter from your resume and a job description in under a minute.
use_cases: Drafting a cover letter quickly for a job application
Tailoring a letter to a specific job description
Rewriting individual paragraphs of a cover letter
Overcoming writer's block when applying to jobs
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes your resume and a job description as input and generates a complete cover letter draft, which the page says takes under 60 seconds. It claims to analyze the job posting for key requirements, match them against your experience, and highlight relevant achievements. It includes keyword optimization aimed at applicant tracking systems. You can edit the draft in a built-in rich text editor, regenerate specific paragraphs, or adjust tone, length, and focus areas.
notable: Generates a full draft from resume and job description in under 60 seconds
Keyword optimization for applicant tracking systems (ATS)
Regenerate or rewrite individual paragraphs with one click
Built-in rich text editor for manual fine-tuning
caveats: Page says it starts free and requires an upgrade for paid plans, but the pricing details are not shown in the page text
Marketing claims such as '70% of cover letters never reach a human' and '1.2M+ users' are not independently verified
